Karnataka Minister Claims Ethanol Blending Harms Vehicles

Karnataka Minister DK Shivakumar has stated that ethanol blending in petrol is negatively impacting vehicle mileage and causing engine damage. He directed his concerns towards the central government regarding these claims.
